component.name: Voltius
component.summary: SSH, SFTP and serial client with an encrypted vault

description.p: This is a community package of Voltius, maintained independently and unaffiliated with the Voltius project. It repackages the official upstream .deb unmodified and follows upstream releases automatically.

Voltius is a local-first SSH, SFTP and serial client — an open-source alternative to Termius. Hosts, keys and identities live in an encrypted vault that you can sync end-to-end encrypted through storage you own.

ul.li: SSH terminals with split panes and input broadcast; sessions that survive disconnects and restarts.
SFTP between hosts and your machine, with drag and drop.
End-to-end encrypted sync through a GitHub Gist, a Cloudflare Worker or any S3-compatible bucket.
One-click import from Termius and MobaXterm; export as open JSON.
Docker and Proxmox LXC management, a process manager and live host stats.
Plugins, and an optional local MCP server for AI coding tools.

description.p: Permissions: this package grants network access, the GPU and the Secret Service for stored credentials. It grants no filesystem access — the vault lives inside the sandbox, and SFTP files are picked through the file chooser. Some capabilities are not granted by default; enable the ones you need with flatpak override:

ul.li: Import hosts from your ~/.ssh/config and use your existing key files: flatpak override --user --filesystem=~/.ssh:ro app.voltius.Voltius
Transfer files to and from any folder in your home: flatpak override --user --filesystem=home app.voltius.Voltius

description.p: Scope: the local terminal tab runs inside the sandbox, on the shells the Flatpak runtime provides — not on your host system. Remote sessions are unaffected.
